jobs.title: Patient Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
Patient Care Coordinator

At Pelvic Health & Wellness, compassionate and individualized care is our foundation, and excellence is our standard.

We are seeking a Patient Care Coordinator who can bring warmth, organization, and initiative to our team. This role is more than a front desk position—it is the bridge that connects our clients to the care they need and the heartbeat of our operations, ensuring that every client is welcomed, supported, and guided through their Pelvic Health & Wellness experience.

We are a specialized pelvic floor therapy clinic and wellness collective dedicated to guiding people of all ages and genders with pelvic floor concerns toward greater confidence, resilience, and long-term relief. Our services include one-on-one physical therapy, patient education, community workshops, and whole-person wellness support—all offered in a calm, welcoming, and client-centered environment.

Our Core Values
Compassionate Service – Providing client-centered care with humility and empathy.
Supportive Collaboration – Building each other up and fostering community partnerships.
Initiative & Adaptability – Taking action, embracing challenges, and remaining flexible.
Excellence & Growth – Striving for the highest standards while learning and innovating.
Integrity & Accountability – Acting with honesty and professionalism in every interaction.

Why Join Pelvic Health & Wellness?
Work in a calm, supportive clinic with variety throughout the week.
Play a vital role in helping clients feel seen, supported, and empowered in their health journey.
Contribute to smooth clinic operations and creative projects, outreach, and community events.
Enjoy a stable weekday schedule — no weekends or holidays.

Our Ideal Candidate
You are someone who…
Thrives in a welcoming environment while being comfortable switching between tasks.
Is personally invested in health, wellness, and community connection.
Has 1+ year of administrative, client services, or front desk experience in health, wellness, or high-touch service settings.
Excels at organization, scheduling, and communication while maintaining accuracy.
Has exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to anticipate needs and problem-solve.
Works well on a collaborative team and contributes to both client care and clinic growth.

Qualities we value:
Calm & Personable – You create a sense of ease for clients and colleagues.
Detail-Oriented – You keep tasks organized and follow through consistently.
Adaptable – You’re comfortable switching between different types of work.
Proactive – You look for ways to improve processes and anticipate needs.
Growth-Minded – You’re excited to learn and take on new challenges.

Key Responsibilities
Client Support & Scheduling
Greet and assist clients with warmth and professionalism.
Manage appointment scheduling, confirmations, check-ins, and check-outs.
Handle invoicing and payments.
Respond to new client inquiries via phone call and manage intake paperwork.
Maintain clear communication with clients, providers, and referral sources.
Provide knowledgeable answers about services.

Clinic Operations
Support therapists with daily operations and clinic flow.
Ensure treatment rooms are organized and ready.
Light cleaning and laundry (sheets, towels, pillow cases).
Order clinic supplies (non-medical).
Prepare folders, packets, and gift bags.
Monitor automated email flows.
Run reports, complete data entry, and assist with follow-up tasks.

Marketing & Community Engagement
Thank referral sources and send information packets to new provider partners.
Prepare and send quarterly marketing materials.

Event Support
Help prepare and coordinate workshops/events.
Create, update, and distribute event email sequences.

Position Details
Schedule:  Monday 8-6:30. Tuesday 7-6:30. Thursday 8-6:30. Friday 7-3:30. No weekends or holidays. No weekends or holidays.
Compensation: $20-22 per hour.

To Apply
Please send your resume and a cover letter explaining why you’d be a great fit for our team to Lauryn@pelvichealthandwellness.com
Job Type: Full-time
Pay: $20.00 - $22.00 per hour

Benefits:
Employee discount
On-site gym
Paid time off
Paid training

Work Location: In person at our Franklin office. First two weeks of training will take place at our Whitefish Bay office.

jobs.title: Workers' Compensation Certified Nurse Case Manager
jobs.description:
Location:
Oak Ridge, TN

Job Title:
Workers' Compensation Certified Nurse Case Manager

Career Level:
Senior Specialist

Job Specialty:
Workers' Compensation Case Management

What You'll Do

Gather relevant information to assist in the investigation and evaluation of workers’ compensation claims through interviews, verbal or written communications, and medical records.
Responsible for helping to ensure injured parties receive appropriate treatment directly related to their compensable injury.
Attends medical appointments with injured employees.
Communicates in person and by telephone with patients, medical providers, attorneys, and insurance carrier to provide ongoing case management.
Works collaboratively with claim handlers/adjusters to ensure that all injured parties are on an appropriate treatment plan and to manage medical treatment to resolution. Participate in periodic claim reviews.
Work with others in a tactful, congenial, and professional manner so as to gain their trust and cooperation and accomplish assigned tasks.
Exchange ideas, information, and opinions with others to jointly arrive at decisions, conclusions, solutions, or otherwise solve disputes.
Responsible for ongoing evaluation of treatment or return to work plan within established protocols.
Interact with Occupational Health Services (OHS) and Environmental Safety &Health (ES&H) to obtain or clarify clinical information and participate in in-house case reviews.
Maintain high standard of file documentation to ensure attention to detail and file accuracy, and provide timely reports, responses, and case updates.
Provide comprehensive medical case management oversight of workers’ compensation claims.
Advocate for appropriate services and treatment to attain best practices standards, maximum medical improvement and successful return-to-work.
Communicate with employees, line management, Occupational Health Services (OHS), occupational safety and health administration (OSHA) recordkeeping, benefits, internal and external counsel, external providers, and others to ensure understanding of, and cooperation with, the recommended treatment plans and the goal of returning employees to meaningful work.
Maintain required continuing education as outlined by CCM, TN Bureau of Workers’ Compensation, and CNS.

What You Can Expect

Meaningful work and unique opportunities to support missions vital to national and global security
Top-notch, dedicated colleagues
Generous pay and benefits with a stable organization
Career advancement and professional development programs
Work-life balance fostered through flexible work options and wellness initiatives

Minimum Job Requirements

Bachelor’s degree: Minimum 7 years of relevant experience as a workers’ compensation nurse case manager. Typical experience ranging from 10 to 15 years.
RN with current state license required
CCM certification required

Preferred Job Requirements

Knowledge of and working familiarity with the Official Disability Guidelines (ODG)
Knowledge of and working familiarity with the MD Guidelines
Documentation and calculation of cost savings per case
Strong problem solving and analytical skills
Excellent interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills
Good computer skills including use of Word and Excel
Ability to interface with treating physicians, division managers, OHS staff, and employees
Excellent organization skills

Why Y-12?

You get #morethanajob. We encourage employees to achieve a healthy personal balance among home, work and the community. One of the ways we embrace work-life balance is by offering flexible work arrangements that provide alternatives to the traditional workweek, while still meeting business needs. Top talent and personal commitment mean more to our success than any other factors, so we reward our people with the kinds of benefits that make a positive difference in the quality of their lives. Benefits such as: medical plan, prescription drug plan, vision plan, dental plan, employer matched 401(k) savings plan, disability coverage, education reimbursement and many more. Want to stay healthy and fit but hate the cost of a gym membership? Take advantage of one of our onsite workout facilities and eat healthy in our onsite cafeterias. Much more than a workplace, at Y-12, you can build a career that lasts a lifetime.

Notes

The minimum education and experience for the lowest career level in the job posting range are listed under Minimum Job Requirements. Successful candidates hired into a higher career level than the minimum in the range must meet the requirements listed in the job leveling charts for the career level into which they are being hired.

If a range of Career Levels is posted, i.e., Senior Associate to Senior Specialist, internal applicants already in one of the Career Levels would come across at their current Career Level. Internal applicants currently in a lower level Career Level would move to the lowest posted Career Level.

Requires a Q clearance; however all qualified candidates will be considered regardless of their current clearance status. The ability to obtain and maintain a Department of Energy Q clearance is required.

This position may require entry into the Material Access Areas (MAA) and participation in the Human Reliability Program (10 C.F.R. Part 712), which requires successful competition of a DOE counterintelligence evaluation and may include a counterintelligence-scope polygraph examination.

This position may be categorized as a “designated position” identified by 10 C.F.R. Part 709, requiring successful completion of a DOE counterintelligence evaluation that may include a counterintelligence-scope polygraph examination.

CNS is a drug-free workplace. Candidates accepting a job offer will be required to pass a pre-placement physical, drug screening and background investigation. As an employee, you may be required to receive and maintain a security clearance from the United States Department of Energy in order to meet eligibility requirements for access to sensitive information or matter. U.S. citizenship is a requirement for security clearance applicants. All employees are subject to being randomly selected for drug testing without advance notification.

CNS is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment based on merit and without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, protected veteran status or disability.

jobs.title: Patient Care Coordinator I
jobs.description:
The Patient Care Coordinator manages communication between patients, family members, attorneys, and care providers in all aspects of patient care. The Patient Care Coordinator I answers incoming calls, emails, and chats to ensure each patient receives the best service possible. This position is a dedicated partner to clinical staff and is responsible for ensuring quality patient care.  

What you will do:

Handle calls from patients, attorneys, nurse case managers, adjusters, and other stakeholders. 

Provide accurate information and assistance, ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction.

Assess caller concerns, determine the best course of action, and resolve or escalate issues promptly.

Utilize problem-solving skills to address and mitigate escalated Tier 1 calls effectively.

Schedule patient appointments, ensuring optimal use of clinic resources.

Answer pre-visit questions and provide necessary information to patients.

Partner with clinical staff to ensure best practices in handling medication and authorization calls. 

Facilitate communication between clinical and administrative teams.

Ensure compliance with professional standards and regulatory requirements for insurance.

Verify PPO/Medicare insurance patients and create charts as needed.

Route calls to appropriate departments when necessary.

Enter data and information accurately into the desired database location. Complete tasks assigned by Tier 3 within the specified deadlines.

Use Zendesk to track and manage tasks provided by Tier 3.

Answer incoming chats from patients and stakeholders, providing timely and accurate responses.  Become familiar with California work rules and regulations.

Maintain basic knowledge of commercial HMO/PPO insurance and personal injury cases.

Act as a liaison between the UR Department, adjusters, attorneys, and the authorization department to secure treatment authorizations.

Navigate Electronic Medical Records (EMR) systems to follow up on requests and resolve issues.

Document calls and interactions accurately.

Adhere to HIPAA and confidentiality laws regarding the protection of health information.

Partner with Medical Assistants (MAs) and Scribes to promptly handle medication issues.

Assumes other responsibilities as appropriate to the position and organizational needs.

Qualifications:

High school diploma or GED

Customer service: 1 year (Preferred) 

Medical office: 2 years (Preferred)

Bilingual in Spanish preferred (Preferred)

Compensation Range: 

$21.00 to $22.00 Hourly 

All compensation ranges are posted based on internal equity, job requirements, experience, and geographical locations.

Why You'll Love Working Here:

Amazing work/life balance

Generous Medical, Dental, Vision, and Prescription benefits (PPO & HMO) 

401(K) Plan with Employer Matching 

License & Tuition Reimbursements

Paid Time Off

Holiday Pay & Floating Holiday

Employee Perks and Discount Programs

Supportive environment to help you grow and succeed

Boomerang Healthcare (BHC) is a multidisciplinary and comprehensive team of experienced, committed healthcare providers that treat pain. Our team of doctors approaches each patient with one goal in mind: to help patients return to normal daily activities. We work with our patients to identify the cause of their pain and create a personalized treatment plan, recognizing that no two patients are alike, and neither is their pain. Our providers create a comprehensive care plan, then monitor, manage and coordinate patient access to health services at BHC. 

Boomerang Healthcare strives to be a diverse workforce that reflects, at all job levels, the patients we serve. We are an equal opportunity employer. Boomerang Healthcare is committed to compliance with the American Disabilities Act. If you require reasonable accommodation during the application process or have a question regarding an essential job function, please contact us.

jobs.description:
Jobright is your personal AI job search agent that transforms the way you do job search from solo, time-consuming efforts to a fast, expert-guided journey, simplifying every job search step and accelerating your route to the best job outcomes. The New Grad Data Analyst will help understand the needs and behaviors of job seekers by analyzing data, customer feedback, and research findings to improve customer satisfaction and retention.

Why Join Us

• Build real, production AI agents used by real users
• High ownership and impact
• Work at the intersection of AI, agents, and product
• Shape how people experience AI-driven job search

Responsibilities

• Analyze customer behavior, engagement, retention, and satisfaction
• Combine quantitative data with surveys and support feedback
• Build customer segments, dashboards, and recurring reports

• Measure the impact of customer-experience initiatives
• Present findings and recommendations to cross-functional teams

Required

• Recent graduate in Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Psychology, Business, or a related field
• Strong SQL and spreadsheet skills
• Understanding of statistics and customer-behavior analysis
• Strong written and verbal communication skills
• Ability to work effectively in a remote environment

Preferred

• Experience with surveys, segmentation, or customer research
• Familiarity with Python, Tableau, Looker, or product analytics tools
• Experience analyzing support, CRM, or user-feedback data
• Interest in consumer technology and AI products

Location:

Job Title:
Workers' Compensation Certified Nurse Case Manager

Career Level:
Senior Specialist

Workers' Compensation Case Management

What You'll Do

Gather relevant information to assist in the investigation and evaluation of workers’ compensation claims through interviews, verbal or written communications, and medical records.
Responsible for helping to ensure injured parties receive appropriate treatment directly related to their compensable injury.
Attends medical appointments with injured employees.
Communicates in person and by telephone with patients, medical providers, attorneys, and insurance carrier to provide ongoing case management.
Works collaboratively with claim handlers/adjusters to ensure that all injured parties are on an appropriate treatment plan and to manage medical treatment to resolution. Participate in periodic claim reviews.
Work with others in a tactful, congenial, and professional manner so as to gain their trust and cooperation and accomplish assigned tasks.
Exchange ideas, information, and opinions with others to jointly arrive at decisions, conclusions, solutions, or otherwise solve disputes.
Responsible for ongoing evaluation of treatment or return to work plan within established protocols.
Interact with Occupational Health Services (OHS) and Environmental Safety &Health (ES&H) to obtain or clarify clinical information and participate in in-house case reviews.
Maintain high standard of file documentation to ensure attention to detail and file accuracy, and provide timely reports, responses, and case updates.
Provide comprehensive medical case management oversight of workers’ compensation claims.
Advocate for appropriate services and treatment to attain best practices standards, maximum medical improvement and successful return-to-work.
Communicate with employees, line management, Occupational Health Services (OHS), occupational safety and health administration (OSHA) recordkeeping, benefits, internal and external counsel, external providers, and others to ensure understanding of, and cooperation with, the recommended treatment plans and the goal of returning employees to meaningful work.
Maintain required continuing education as outlined by CCM, TN Bureau of Workers’ Compensation, and CNS.

What You Can Expect

Meaningful work and unique opportunities to support missions vital to national and global security
Top-notch, dedicated colleagues
Generous pay and benefits with a stable organization
Career advancement and professional development programs
Work-life balance fostered through flexible work options and wellness initiatives

Minimum Job Requirements

Bachelor’s degree: Minimum 7 years of relevant experience as a workers’ compensation nurse case manager. Typical experience ranging from 10 to 15 years.
RN with current state license required
CCM certification required

Preferred Job Requirements

Knowledge of and working familiarity with the Official Disability Guidelines (ODG)
Knowledge of and working familiarity with the MD Guidelines
Documentation and calculation of cost savings per case
Strong problem solving and analytical skills
Excellent interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills
Good computer skills including use of Word and Excel
Ability to interface with treating physicians, division managers, OHS staff, and employees
Excellent organization skills

Why Y-12?

You get #morethanajob. We encourage employees to achieve a healthy personal balance among home, work and the community. One of the ways we embrace work-life balance is by offering flexible work arrangements that provide alternatives to the traditional workweek, while still meeting business needs. Top talent and personal commitment mean more to our success than any other factors, so we reward our people with the kinds of benefits that make a positive difference in the quality of their lives. Benefits such as: medical plan, prescription drug plan, vision plan, dental plan, employer matched 401(k) savings plan, disability coverage, education reimbursement and many more. Want to stay healthy and fit but hate the cost of a gym membership? Take advantage of one of our onsite workout facilities and eat healthy in our onsite cafeterias. Much more than a workplace, at Y-12, you can build a career that lasts a lifetime.

Notes

The Patient Care Coordinator manages communication between patients, family members, attorneys, and care providers in all aspects of patient care. The Patient Care Coordinator I answers incoming calls, emails, and chats to ensure each patient receives the best service possible. This position is a dedicated partner to clinical staff and is responsible for ensuring quality patient care.  

What you will do:

Handle calls from patients, attorneys, nurse case managers, adjusters, and other stakeholders. 

Provide accurate information and assistance, ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction.

Assess caller concerns, determine the best course of action, and resolve or escalate issues promptly.

Utilize problem-solving skills to address and mitigate escalated Tier 1 calls effectively.

Schedule patient appointments, ensuring optimal use of clinic resources.

Answer pre-visit questions and provide necessary information to patients.

Partner with clinical staff to ensure best practices in handling medication and authorization calls. 

Facilitate communication between clinical and administrative teams.

Ensure compliance with professional standards and regulatory requirements for insurance.

Verify PPO/Medicare insurance patients and create charts as needed.

Route calls to appropriate departments when necessary.

Enter data and information accurately into the desired database location. Complete tasks assigned by Tier 3 within the specified deadlines.

Use Zendesk to track and manage tasks provided by Tier 3.

Answer incoming chats from patients and stakeholders, providing timely and accurate responses.  Become familiar with California work rules and regulations.

Maintain basic knowledge of commercial HMO/PPO insurance and personal injury cases.

Act as a liaison between the UR Department, adjusters, attorneys, and the authorization department to secure treatment authorizations.

Navigate Electronic Medical Records (EMR) systems to follow up on requests and resolve issues.

Document calls and interactions accurately.

Adhere to HIPAA and confidentiality laws regarding the protection of health information.

Partner with Medical Assistants (MAs) and Scribes to promptly handle medication issues.

Assumes other responsibilities as appropriate to the position and organizational needs.

High school diploma or GED

Customer service: 1 year (Preferred) 

Medical office: 2 years (Preferred)

Bilingual in Spanish preferred (Preferred)

Amazing work/life balance

License & Tuition Reimbursements

Paid Time Off

Employee Perks and Discount Programs
